description: vh1981 plugin hooks — injects the default guidelines (and re-injects on the next prompt when that was cancelled), keeps the devlog status line installed, checks the checkout in to the knowledge base, logs prompts, and keeps the repo's session list for restoring tmux windows

hooks.command: /bin/sh -c 'command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "$1" hook; cat >/dev/null' sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sessions.py"
